name: maintainer-mode
description: Turn GitHub issues into defensible pull requests with policy gates, duplicate checks, and evidence-backed test claims.

interface.shortDescription: Ship open-source PRs without invented certainty.
interface.longDescription: An evidence-first contribution workflow for Codex: inspect repository policy, screen issue and duplicate risk, implement focused changes, record privacy-preserving verification receipts, and follow up on reviews without unauthorized public actions.
defaultPrompt: Triage this GitHub issue before I write code.
Prove which checks passed on this exact tree.
Inspect this pull request for the next action.
